description: The npm manifest for a JavaScript transpiler: a scoped name, the bin CLI command, the library entry point, a test script, and metadata.

steps.description: This is `package.json`, the npm equivalent of `pyproject.toml`. The page says to create it in the root of your project. `name` uses a scope, `@yourname/`, to avoid name conflicts, and the page says to replace `yourname` with your npm username. `version` is `0.1.0`, and `description` names the package.
`bin` declares the CLI command. The page says that when a user installs your package globally, npm puts `mylang` on their PATH pointing at `bin/mylang.js`.
`main` is the entry point when another JavaScript file requires your package as a library. The page gives the example `const { transpile } = require('@yourname/mylang')`.
`scripts.test` runs the test file with Node. `keywords` lists search terms, and `license` is MIT.

title: package.json
